tags.name: Sampling Points
tags.description: These are the locations from which samples are taken. Each has a prefLabel, a notation (which is unique among sampling-points in WQA) and a geographic location (available in both BritishNational Grid and lat/long versions), among other properties.

tags.name: Observations
tags.description: Observations are the results of measurements taken on samples. Each observation is linked to a sample, sampling, and sampling point, and includes a determinand (the property measured) and a value. Observations can be quantity values, bounds, or coded results.

tags.name: Samples & Sampling
tags.description: Samples are taken from a sampling point in the act of sampling. Samples contain source information (i.e. material taken), and Samplings contain information about the sampling event, such as datetime, and purpose. Both are linked to a sampling point.

tags.name: Codelists
tags.description: These codelists are used to provide controlled vocabularies for various concepts in the Water Quality Archive. They include determinands, units, sample materials, sampling point statuses, and sampling point types. Reading the API user's documentation is recommended to understand the serialization of these codelists if interpreting them as linked data.

tags.name: Contexts
tags.description: Provides access to the JSON-LD context files used by the API. The endpoint returns the filename of the context resource requested (these filenames are embedded/hardcoded into the API responses and live under `src/contexts/`, e.g. `wqa_samplesampling_context.json-ld`). Clients can retrieve the context file if they need the explicit term-to-IRI mappings, but this is usually unnecessary since the other endpoints already link to the appropriate context.
